text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — Asterion private onboarding. Cutover is Wed 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Need quick confirmations before we freeze configs: KMS key rotation policy, audit log forwarder endpoint, and the egress ports for token auth. Can people chime in?

alice_net: I can take networking. Are we opening outbound to a managed Splunk ingest? Need IPs and ports.

maria_cs: Yes Splunk HEC to be used. They sent `https://splunk.asterion.ingest.company` on 9410/tcp. Also customer asked for mutual TLS between our forwarder and their endpoint.

tom_infra: For mutual TLS we'll need the client cert in the private-runtime. Two ops notes: 1) we cannot store private keys unencrypted on hosts; 2) KMS must allow decrypt for the service account principal.

ryan_security: Re: KMS — we should use separate key per-tenant with an allowlist for principals. Example minimal policy we vetted last quarter:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-private-agent"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}```
Change the principal to Asterion's enrollment role. Also set key rotation to 365 days per policy.

maria_cs: Perfect. Tom/Alice, can you confirm that the private-agent role we'll pass to KMS is `arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/asterion-redwood-agent`? That's what Asterion provided.

tom_infra: Confirmed, that's the role. We'll add it to the key policy and to the instance-profile mapping. I'll push a change to the infra repo in a minute.

alice_net: Network side — Splunk HEC on 9410 from our private runtime egress. Also need outbound 443 to `auth.asterion.internal` for token exchange. I'll update the egress ACLs and post the terraform change.

maria_cs: Thanks. Ryan — audit logs: Asterion requires immutable logs for 90 days and SCIM events pushed. Are we okay with our forwarder labeling and retention?

ryan_security: We can tag logs with tenant id and push to their Splunk index. Immutable retention is policy on their side; we forward raw events and set `X-Redwood-Retention: 90d` header for tracking. Need legal signoff for retention SLA; cc: @maria_cs to loop in customer.

maria_cs: I'll escalate retention SLA in the customer call today. Two follow-ups: 1) Tom — after you push infra change, can you run a smoke deploy to staging and paste the `deploy-bot` output? 2) Alice — share terraform PR link.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by tom_infra for `private-runtime/asterion` -> staging. Build 2026.04.01-183. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/2026.04.01-183

tom_infra: Pushed infra PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4722 — updates instance-profile + KMS policy. Kicking a staging deploy now.

alice_net: PR for network rules: https://git.internal/redwood/net/pull/1987 — adds egress 9410 and 443 to customer endpoints, mTLS policy notes in the description.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded for `private-runtime/asterion` (build 2026.04.01-183). Smoke checks: key decrypt ✅, splunk ingest handshake ✅, auth token exchange ✅.

maria_cs: Fantastic. Capture for the enablement doc: add steps for key rotation (owner: ryan_security), network ACL checklist (owner: alice_net), infra mapping (owner: tom_infra). I'll update the onboarding ticket.

ryan_security: One more risk item — renewal flagged: Asterion asked if we can support a 30-day retention SLT for logs at no extra cost. That impacts storage budget. I'm marking this as a potential renewal risk.

maria_cs: Noted. I'll start a pricing/options thread with sales. For now, flagging in account health as `medium` risk and capturing the ask in the cutover notes.

alice_net: ETA for prod cutover config to be submitted by Tue EOD.

tom_infra: I'll coordinate the prod key policy rollout and schedule a short maintenance window with Asterion ops.

maria_cs: Great — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, drop here. I'll post updated onboarding doc + action checklist after the customer call. :white_check_mark:
